answer: Streak multipliers: each epoch an identity mines consecutively raises its reward weight ×1.05, capped at ×3 after 23 epochs. Any gap resets to ×1. A farm rotating fresh keys never accrues streak, so its effective hashpower share stays flat while honest nodes compound. The whisper across the network is the reset event; the relic is a long unbroken streak, costly to fake since it requires sustained uptime and real work. A gale of cheap identities can't outpace a single ×3 node without paying 3× the compute for zero multiplier. Works because compounding rewards make patience cheaper than forgery.
